items.title: Respond to offer to extend fixed-term employment contract
items.quote: Ihre Entscheidung erbitten wir binnen 6 Werktagen ab Datum dieses Schreibens; als Werktage zählen dabei Montag bis Samstag, gesetzliche Feiertage nicht.
items.computation: Letter is dated Friday, 16.04.2027. The period runs 'ab Datum dieses Schreibens' (from the date of this letter); applying the standard §187(1) BGB rule for periods beginning with a specified day, the day of the letter itself is not counted and the count starts on the following day, Saturday 17.04.2027. The letter explicitly defines 'Werktage' as Monday through Saturday, excluding statutory public holidays (Sundays are excluded, Saturdays count). Counting 6 such Werktage: Day 1 = Sat 17.04.2027; Sun 18.04.2027 is skipped (not a Werktag); Day 2 = Mon 19.04.2027; Day 3 = Tue 20.04.2027; Day 4 = Wed 21.04.2027; Day 5 = Thu 22.04.2027; Day 6 = Fri 23.04.2027. No NRW public holidays fall in this window (Karfreitag/Ostermontag 2027 already passed on 26./29.03.2027, and Tag der Arbeit is 01.05.2027, outside this range). The resulting last day, Friday 23.04.2027, is itself a Werktag, so no further extension under §193 BGB is needed.

warnings: The deadline is defined as running 'ab Datum dieses Schreibens' (from the letter's own date) rather than from receipt/Zugang, and whether the letter's date itself counts as the first day is not explicitly stated by the sender; the due date above assumes the day of the letter is not counted (standard §187 BGB default), but if the employer intends the letter's date to count as day one, the deadline could instead fall one Werktag earlier (22.04.2027) — this should be double-checked with the sender.
